scope: Test-environment verification for the task-bound H3 fallback correction
summary: Focused routing and identity tests pass, but a full-suite rerun was not established because the local virtual environment is a dataless placeholder and the remote source/test trees are from different revisions. The observed full-suite failures are recorded as infrastructure/version drift rather than hidden as a successful full run.
evidence: The local .venv/pyvenv.cfg reports 321 bytes but zero allocated blocks with the dataless flag; Python stalls while reading the environment, so it was not modified or used for claims.
The synchronized focused suite tests/test_h3_identity_routing.py plus tests/test_h3_identity_rsi.py passes 22/22 in the remote .venv-h3 environment.
Ruff passes the routing module, delivery script, and routing tests.
The remote repository's own 113-test suite reports 105 passes and eight failures in unrelated local-video and BWM tests whose test signatures predate their implementation signatures.

Running the current 96-file local test tree against the older/incomplete remote source tree fails collection on 50 missing or version-drifted modules, so that combination is not a valid full-suite result.
An attempt to stage the complete current source tree under /tmp stalled while reading dataless local source placeholders and was terminated without changing project files or evidence.
lessons: A passing focused suite is valid evidence for the changed subsystem but must not be relabelled as a passing full repository suite.
Remote tests and source must come from the same revision before aggregate failures can be attributed to a patch.
Dataless workspace placeholders should be hydrated by the workspace owner or replaced by a clean checkout/environment, not silently rewritten during a correctness fix.
limitations: No clean same-revision full-suite result is available in this turn.
The eight remote full-suite failures and 50 mixed-tree collection errors are outside the H3 routing files changed here.
next_actions: Hydrate or recreate the local virtual environment, then run the full current test tree from the same checkout.
Keep the 22 focused passes and Ruff result as the acceptance evidence for this bounded routing correction.
